title: Set 213

sentences.ko: 정말 미안한데 나 이제 가 봐야 해. 오늘 밤에 이웃집 개를 밖에 내보내 주기로 했거든. 그 불쌍한 녀석이 아침부터 집 안에만 갇혀 있어서, 더 기다리게 하면 마음이 안 좋을 것 같아.
sentences.text: I'm really sorry, but I've got to head out. I told my neighbor I'd let her dog out tonight, and the poor guy's been stuck inside since this morning, so I feel bad making him wait any longer.

alts.text: Super sorry, I gotta run. I said I'd let my neighbor's dog out tonight, and the poor guy's been cooped up since this morning, so I don't wanna make him wait.

I sincerely apologize, but I must leave now. I promised my neighbor that I would let her dog out this evening, and the poor animal has been inside since this morning, so I would feel terrible making him wait any longer.

sentences.note: **head out** 은 지금 있는 자리를 뜨다, 나가 보다라는 뜻입니다. **I've got to** 는 have to 를 말로 할 때 흔히 쓰는 꼴이고, casual 의 **cooped up** 은 좁은 곳에 갇혀 답답하게 지낸다는 말입니다.
sentences.situation: 저녁 모임에서 먼저 일어날 구실 만들기

sentences.ko: 자, 살인 사건 다큐 또 보는 건 안 돼. 어젯밤에도 봤는데 너 중간에 잠들었잖아. 그러니까 이번엔 내가 고를 차례야.
sentences.text: Okay, we are not watching another murder documentary. We did that last night and you fell asleep halfway through, so I get to pick this time.

alts.text: Nope, no more murder documentaries. We did one last night and you passed out halfway through, so it's my pick this time.
We will not be watching another murder documentary. We watched one last night and you fell asleep halfway through, so I believe it is my turn to choose this time.

sentences.note: **I get to pick** 은 이번엔 내가 고를 권리가 있다는 말입니다. **halfway through** 는 보거나 하는 도중에, 중간쯤에서라는 뜻이고, casual 의 **passed out** 은 곯아떨어졌다는 뜻입니다.

sentences.ko: 왜 그런지 모르겠는데 자꾸 새벽 세 시쯤에 깨. 그러고 나면 머릿속이 도무지 꺼지질 않아. 그래서 겨우 다시 졸릴 때쯤이면 벌써 일어날 시간이 다 돼 있어.
sentences.text: I don't know what's going on, but I keep waking up at like three, and then my brain just won't shut off. So by the time I'm finally tired again, it's almost time to get up.

alts.text: No idea what's up, but I keep waking up around three and my brain just won't quit. By the time I'm tired again, it's pretty much time to get up.
I am not sure what is happening, but I continue to wake at around three o'clock, and then my mind simply will not rest. By the time I finally feel tired again, it is nearly time to get up.

sentences.note: **shut off** 는 기계가 꺼지듯 생각이 멈춘다는 말로, 머리가 안 꺼진다는 것은 잡생각이 계속 돈다는 뜻입니다. **by the time** 은 ~할 때쯤이면이고, at **like** three 의 like 는 대략, ~쯤이라는 뜻입니다.

sentences.ko: 나도 그러고 싶은데, 이번 주말에 동생네 부엌 손보는 거 도와주기로 이미 말해 놨어. 그래도 일요일 밤에 일손이 더 필요하면 문자 줘. 그때 내가 얼마나 지쳤는지 보고 말해 줄게.
sentences.text: I wish I could, but I already told my brother I'd help him with his kitchen this weekend. If you still need an extra pair of hands on Sunday night, though, text me and I'll see how tired I am.

alts.text: Ugh, I'd love to, but I already said I'd help my brother with his kitchen this weekend. If you still need an extra pair of hands Sunday night, though, text me and I'll see how wiped I am.

I wish I were able to, but I have already promised my brother that I would help him with his kitchen this weekend. However, if you still need an extra pair of hands on Sunday evening, please send me a message and I will see how tired I am.

sentences.note: **I wish I could** 는 그러고 싶지만 못 한다고 부드럽게 거절하는 말입니다. **an extra pair of hands** 는 도와줄 사람 하나 더, 일손이라는 뜻이고, casual 의 **wiped** 는 완전히 녹초가 됐다는 말입니다.

sentences.ko: 솔직히 별거 없었어. 토요일에 룸메이트가 나를 방탈출 카페에 끌고 갔거든. 시간 안에 못 나오긴 했는데, 생각보다 훨씬 재밌었어.
sentences.text: Not much, honestly. My roommate dragged me to one of those escape rooms on Saturday, and we didn't get out in time, but it was actually a lot more fun than I thought it'd be.

alts.text: Eh, not a lot. My roommate dragged me to an escape room Saturday. We didn't make it out in time, but it was way more fun than I expected.
Not a great deal, to be honest. My roommate insisted on taking me to an escape room on Saturday, and although we did not get out in time, it was considerably more enjoyable than I had expected.

sentences.note: **Not much** 는 뭐 했냐는 물음에 별거 안 했다고 답하는 말입니다. **dragged me to** 는 내키지 않는 나를 억지로 데려갔다는 뜻이고, **a lot more fun than I thought** 는 생각보다 훨씬 재밌었다는 말입니다.

reviewed: 1번 casual 의 끝부분(so I feel bad making him wait any longer)이 text 와 글자까지 똑같아서 더 짧은 구어(so I don't wanna make him wait)로 바꿨습니다.
4번 formal 의 I would like to 는 I wish I could 의 아쉬워하는 느낌이 빠지고 뜻이 약해져서 I wish I were able to 로 바꿨습니다.
5번 note 가 Not much 를 요즘 어떠냐는 물음에 하는 답이라고 설명했는데, 이 상황은 주말에 뭐 했냐는 물음이라 거기에 맞게 고쳤습니다.
